name: St. Charles County, MO
findings: St. Charles County has 1,084 nonprofit organizations. 452 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 351 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Charles County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 12 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 27 would.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through education groups? Where else does that happen?
